subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: After converging sender grouping on canonical `accessGroups`, may a pre-auth hook receive raw content from unauthorized DM senders, or must the event be metadata-only by default?
rationale: This determines the permanent confidentiality boundary and public plugin API for content that channel authorization currently blocks.

options.title: Metadata-only by default
options.body: Expose block reason, channel/account, and redacted sender identity without raw message content.

options.title: Explicit raw-content opt-in
options.body: Allow trusted hooks to receive raw content only behind a clearly named opt-in with privacy, rate-limit, and audit documentation.

options.title: No pre-auth event
options.body: Keep blocked content inside channel authorization and rely on pairing or external operational monitoring.

recommendation.title: Metadata-only by default
recommendation.body: Expose block reason, channel/account, and redacted sender identity without raw message content.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the generic access-group architecture and is the strongest available owner to coordinate the API choice with openclaw-secops.
